title: Farm
features:
The ultimate, hands-free kill farm for The Strongest Battlegrounds. Dominate the lobby effortlessly with the most efficient and secure farming script on the market. Engineered for maximum speed and total stealth.

Key Features: Auto Kill & Farm: Obliterate servers and rack up kills instantly. Auto Dodge: God-tier evasive maneuvers to keep you alive. Invis & Auto Execute: Absolute stealth paired with flawless execution. Anti-Staff: Advanced detection to keep your account safe from mods. Auto Serverhop: Keeps the farm fresh by switching lobbies automatically.
